notes.title: Upcoming Steam Next Fest Demo – Director’s Note
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is J. Kim, Director of Ember and Blade.

It’s hard to believe two months have already passed since our last demo. Time has flown by, and once again I want to thank you for the incredible support, feedback, and enthusiasm you shared with us.

Since then, the team has been focused on building new features, expanding content, and reviewing the feedback from our initial release. 

And I’m excited to share that during [b]Steam Next Fest this October[/b],  you will be able to play a [b]new demo of Ember and Blade[/b], featuring deeper story content, new blessings, progression systems, and meaningful changes shaped by our community.


[h2][b]TL;DR[/b][/h2]
- A new demo goes live at the start of [b]October’s Steam Next Fest[/b].
- Play through the story and battles up to [b]Act 2[/b], including early progression and crafting systems.
- Two new angels, [b]Remiel and Galiliel[/b], join the fight with their unique blessings.
- Progression from this demo will [b]not carry over[/b] to future demos or the final release.

[h2][b]Growth & Crafting[/b][/h2]
The core content included in this demo is as follows. Of course, there are many more changes than what’s listed here, but let’s start with the big ones! We’ll introduce the other updates in future posts.

[h3][b]The Sanctuary of Oblivion[/b][/h3]
Each time Fenrix falls, he now revives at the Sanctuary of Oblivion. Here you’ll meet guardian [b]Ariella Ashwood[/b], along with the gentle angel [b]Kaliel[/b] and the witty [b]Haniel[/b].

[b]🌳 Grace of the Arbor: [/b]Offer Ethereal Amber to the great tree to unlock new abilities or strengthen Fenrix’s stats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/2c17ed00998eeebcc15080412ecb1004c4b85ecc.jpg[/img]

[b]🔨 Keke’s Magic Forge: [/b]Keke, a porcelain golem created by Ariella, forges new weapons. Wield the Twin Daggers and the Hammer, each with a distinct combat style.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/1f665575b51f30567df3e1d6a72f1aef5e9c0603.jpg[/img]

[b]⚗️Pea’s Workshop: [/b]Pea, Keke younger brother, crafts relics with powerful effects—sometimes with drawbacks. You can also unlock artifacts originally created for Lumi.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/82833a35b9ccd2258d75bb25afcd68aa08fd9861.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Fields & Combat[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Act 2: The Forsaken Library[/b][/h3]
After defeating Baphomet in the Ashen Meadow, descend into the Forsaken Library on the second layer of the seal. Encounter new monsters, mid-bosses, and the domain’s Warden, [b]Arcanus the Faceless[/b]. Once cleared, you can freely choose between replaying Act 1 or Act 2.
(Note: Progression and unlocks in this demo will not carry over to future builds or the release version.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/e4f112bedf9a1628aa1781bcd4903840c781c64e.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Angels: Remiel & Galiliel[/b][/h3]
Two new angels lend their strength to Fenrix’s expedition.

[b]⚡ Remiel, [/b]Angel of Lightning and Thunder, appears in Act 1.
[b]☠️Galiliel, [/b]Angel of Poison and Conspiracy, joins in Act 2.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/f4d63b6eb8893e25a47f546d68191b603fca9325.png[/img]

[h3][b]Shay’s Hideout[/b][/h3]
After mid-boss encounters, portals may open to [b]Shay’s secret hideout.[/b] This mysterious not-a-cat merchant sells items that can change the course of your run, accompanied by playful banter with Lumi.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/627a89d00bc0855d7881f48f523ab4891d4742be.png[/img]

[h2][b]Community Feedback & Improvements[/b][/h2]
Your feedback has always been a central consideration in building this build. We’ve made significant adjustments to improve the flow of Fenrix’s combat.

[b]- Faster combat: [/b]Increased attack and movement speed, supported by new animations that complement the quicker pace.
[b]- Performance upgrades: [/b]Fixes and optimizations to reduce frame drops and stutters, creating a smoother and more stable gameplay experience.

[h2][b]Closing Thoughts[/b][/h2]
This demo includes more changes than we can cover in a single post, and we will continue sharing details in the weeks ahead. 

Expect updates on additional feedback we’ve addressed, more features in development, and our roadmap leading up to release.

[b]October’s Steam Next Fest[/b] will be an important milestone for Ember and Blade, and we are excited to finally share this step of the journey with you.

As we prepare for the event, the current Ember and Blade demo page will be temporarily unavailable until it is refreshed with a brand-new look and the upcoming demo for Steam Next Fest.

And until she extends her invitation to the Sanctuary of Oblivion...

[b]J. Kim[/b]
Director, Ember and Blade

notes.title: Ember and Blade Patch Notes - 2025.07.24
notes.content: [p]In this update, we have improved game performance, made important balance adjustments, fixed several bugs, and enhanced the user interface based on player feedback. Thanks for your continued support—please stay tuned for upcoming improvements![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Important Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Reduced lag during initial effect triggers to improve overall performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue on certain PCs where camera shake and attack ranges were abnormally displayed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balance Patch[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Reduced Blessing level 5 probability: 35% → 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Blessing 3-star (level 6) probability: 5% → 15%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Fenrix base HP: 200 → 240[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Fenrix base movement speed: 5.3 m/s → 5.8 m/s[/p][/*][*][p]Fenrix ranged weapon movement speed now matches regular speed (4.2 m/s → 5.8 m/s)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Fenrix ranged weapon projectile damage and firing interval[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased Fenrix special attack damage[/p][/*][*][p]Increased dash regeneration: 0.2 dash/sec → 0.25 dash/sec[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Meteor Flower and Flame durations[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy stats up to 6 minutes: HP decreased by 8%, ATK decreased by 40%[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Elite Banshee: removed brief invincibility after attacks, prevented knockback of Fenrix when attacked[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Bark calls (e.g., ShrineSense, Use Artifact, Use Weakness Attack) triggered too frequently.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Baphomet’s HP remained high even after Arbor Reach purifications.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]UI Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Slightly moved Bark UI downward for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Blessing backgrounds now change based on Star level to improve user experience clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]HP bars no longer appear for monsters with very low maximum health.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing Ember and Blade! [/p][p]Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve the game. We look forward to bringing you more exciting updates soon.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]— Ember and Blade Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Character Reveal #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Today, we're pulling back the curtain on six of the central figures shaping the world of [i]Ember and Blade[/i]. As the Sanctuary begins to fracture under the weight of forgotten powers, these characters find themselves drawn into the heart of its unraveling fate. Each carries a different perspective, a different burden—and none of them are here by accident.

From quiet guardians to enigmatic guides, their paths are about to collide as the balance between light and darkness begins to shift. You’ll meet them in moments of chaos, choice, and consequence—and as their stories unfold, so will your role in shaping what comes next.



[h2]Introducing the Characters of [i]Ember and Blade[/i]! [/h2]

[h3][b][i]Fenrix[/i][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/75dc2ef4e77028306b0b928ad60ae6379ff09803.png[/img]
They were never meant to cross paths, yet here they are. Some seek atonement, others revenge. Fenrix talks big, fights hard, and acts like he doesn't care—but behind every scar is a story he won’t tell, each one tied to a demon he hunted while running from something far darker within himself. The only story he truly cares about is the one he can’t rewrite. He came here to fight, but he stays for someone who can’t.

*Mood: Brash on the surface, but shaped by grief and guilt
*Keywords: Bloodstained sword, silent burdens, sharp wit



[h3][i][b]Ariella[/b][/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/455eda0b82a90a6272605bb7a9de638a1f39285e.png[/img]
They call her the Guardian, but she never asked for the title—or the solitude that came with it. She moves with poise and speaks with the sharp precision of someone used to silence being obeyed, placing her trust in no one, especially not the man who fights loud and speaks louder. Beneath the white robes and controlled words, time has left its mark. Something stirs in the darker corners of her memory—something she can’t explain, yet can’t ignore.

*Mood: Cold and regal on the outside, stubborn resilience masking the scars within
*Keywords: A fortress in human form, with hairline fractures you almost miss.



[h3][i][b]Kaliel[/b][/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/84e3298c622893f2f4f2a1027a32c4ce56c119d1.png[/img]
Kaliel is an angel of quiet authority, with a voice that calms and a smile that disarms. He speaks often of justice and balance, rarely of himself, and carries a wisdom that feels both ancient and immediate. He listens more than he speaks, and when he does, every word is carefully chosen—like a blade drawn only when necessary. Behind his calm guidance lies something deeper, something left unsaid. He shows you the path forward, but never promises where it leads. Still, when you falter, he’s the one who reaches for your hand—even if he knows the road ahead ends in sacrifice.

*Mood: Serene, composed, deeply compassionate, ultimately unknowable.  
*Keywords: Olive robe, floating leaf-crystal halo, quiet gaze.  



[h3][i][b]Haniel[/b][/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/39e3acf03bd0b6d62d89c7ae9f29925d7df0fb3f.png[/img]
Haniel appears with a smirk and arms folded, always seeming one step ahead of everyone else. She nags, mocks, and sighs louder than necessary, but she shows up when it matters. She calls it “professional detachment,” though it feels more like a stubborn version of tough love—well, something like it. She’ll never say it out loud, but she does care. Just don’t expect a hug.

*Mood: Dry, sharp, secretly kind in her own way
*Keywords: Full blunt bangs, floating crimson shard halo, white dress with red trim



[h3][i][b]Lumi[/b][/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/919ab49b3a7d536463f5269f7a1aa4b5c04d842a.png[/img]
She’s got paws, she’s got whiskers, but she’s not a cat. Don’t let her catch you calling her one. Lumi is a magical creature with a habit of nagging and a knack for showing up exactly when needed, then vanishing just as quickly. She insists she’s not a cat. You believe her. Mostly.

*Mood: Mischievous, loyal, chipper, dramatic
*Keywords: Slender, floating presence



[h3][i][b]Baphomet[/b][/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577115/02011d0a194f098137bf2829f0fc93f91044abe2.png[/img]
Once a servant, now something else entirely. Baphomet stands with heavy antlers and hollow eyes—not to speak, but to judge. He doesn’t ask questions. He simply measures your worth and usually finds it lacking. He believes in hierarchy, and you’d better hope you’re high enough in it. You probably aren’t.

*Mood: Mockingly polite, judgmental, quietly cruel
*Keywords: deer skull, faded livery, memory made flesh


[h3]And that’s just the beginning.[/h3]

We’ve got more characters in the works—some already taking shape, others still waiting for their moment. As the world of [i]Ember and Blade[/i] continues to grow, we’ll be revealing more stories, faces, and secrets in the updates ahead.



[h3]Want to see where it all leads?[/h3]

[h2]Add [i]Ember and Blade[/i] to your wishlist
and stay tuned for what’s next![/h2]
We’re just getting started.



— The Ember and Blade Team
